cohort: 784 patients who underwent a 1-hour 50 g oral glucose load test during their third trimester
finding: The study found that neither glucose nor insulin levels during the 1-hour gestational diabetes screening test were predictive of fetal macrosomia, low Apgar scores, or birth injuries.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean section had significantly higher glucose and insulin levels than those who had vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was not significantly different between glucose levels or insulin ranges
